items.d: A real card in the phone's wallet, updated on every visit.
Several programs side by side, with rewards and welcome bonuses.
Phone camera, card code or phone number. No hardware to buy.
QR code that changes every 90 seconds, cooldowns, daily limits, alerts.
Promo codes validated at the counter and targeted messages to re-engage customers.
Visits, return rate, peak hours, top customers, per location.
Invite cashiers and managers. Everyone sees only what they need.
One platform for all your shops, with per-store details.
The interface and cards adapt to your customers' language.

security.title: Serious like a bank. Simple like a stamp.
security.d: Every stamp is written to a tamper-proof ledger. Each business's data is strictly isolated. Payments are tracked and sensitive actions logged.

items.q: Do my customers need to install an app?
items.a: No. They scan a QR code, enter their first name and phone, and the card opens in their browser. They can add it to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet.
No. Any smartphone with a camera is enough to scan your customers' cards.
The QR code changes every 90 seconds, only your signed-in staff can stamp, and limits (time between visits, daily maximum) block abuse. Anomalies are flagged.
Pick your plan in your workspace: an invoice is generated, you pay our team in cash and your subscription is activated immediately.
Yes. No commitment: at the end of the paid period, the subscription simply stops if you don't renew.
